title: Explicit Strategy and Model promotion
purpose: Promote an eligible Strategy or Model Challenger only through explicit governed promotion paths.
entry_condition: Owner selects a candidate with valid deterministic eligibility evidence.
authority: Strategy promotion: strategy_challenger_registry; Model promotion: factory governance; Owner action is explicit.

transitions.action: Reload current evidence and revalidate candidate/authority identity

invariants: Strategy and Model Challenger lifecycles are distinct.
No automatic promotion from Optimizer or Factory winner.
Prior Champion/history is preserved for audit/rollback.
failure_behavior: Any stale/missing/failed eligibility evidence blocks promotion.
restart_behavior: A later promotion attempt must re-read current evidence and authority.
rollback_behavior: Promotion code preserves prior records so an explicit rollback/demotion path remains auditable.
